correctness.rationale: Every simplex of NM_2(n) is either a subset of a star or a three-edge triangle; the common star-core deformation retracts onto the subdivided K_n by elementary contractible CW attachments, equivariantly on homology. The pair relative C_2 module is the third exterior power of the signed permutation lattice. The connecting map to the first homology of the graph core is exactly augmentation contraction. The integral splitting Z^n=Z e_1+U shows the contraction is surjective with kernel ∧³U, with no torsion/index assumption. The pair exact sequence forces all other reduced homology to vanish. The third exterior power character is derived from characteristic polynomials; a standalone exact Python check compares signed cellular Lefschetz traces with this formula for all 60 conjugacy classes over n=4..8 and verifies triangle and four-label incidence identities. The finite checks support, but do not replace, the all-n proof.

value.rationale: The source explicitly asks for the natural S_n homology representation of the complete-graph nonmatching complexes. This result gives a natural all-n integral S_n-lattice answer at k=2, not merely an Euler characteristic or routine rank recomputation. The connecting homomorphism between geometric triangle and star-core cycles is identified integrally, yielding a canonical four-label basis, signed full character, and rational quotient consequence. The concrete representation is a structural base case of a motivated open family; it does not purport to solve general k, and no paper-sized generalization is needed for value.
